items.name: iOS
items.path: Expo app in apps/mobile (expo run:ios); TestFlight then App Store
items.why: Where most creators post from; the main app
items.note: Mock data only; needs API sign-in wired and Apple developer account

items.name: Android
items.path: Same Expo codebase (expo run:android); Play internal track then production
items.why: Largest phone base worldwide, strongest outside the US
items.note: Mock data only; needs release signing

items.name: Desktop and mobile web
items.path: Expo web export (apps/mobile) plus server-rendered /@handle and /p/:id pages from apps/api
items.why: Every link works with no install, so every share reaches a person
items.note: Public pages on staging; emera.social serves the landing page and early list

items.name: PWA (installable web app)
items.path: Web manifest, service worker and icons on the Expo web build; add to home screen on iOS, Android and desktop Chrome
items.why: Installable on every screen that has a browser, with no store review

items.name: macOS
items.path: PWA first; later Expo with react-native-macos or an Electron/Tauri shell around the web build
items.why: Desktop creators review work here; the PWA covers most need

items.name: Windows
items.path: PWA first; later react-native-windows or a Tauri shell around the web build
items.why: Large creator base on Windows; the PWA covers most need

items.name: Linux
items.path: PWA or a Tauri/Electron shell around the web build (AppImage, Flatpak)
items.why: Small audience, but a good first contribution from outsiders

items.name: iPad
items.path: Same Expo iOS build with supportsTablet and a wide layout (two-column feed)
items.why: Creators sketch, edit and browse here; one flag plus layout work

items.name: Android tablets
items.path: Same Expo Android build with large-screen layouts and foldable support
items.why: Free once the iPad layout exists

items.name: Apple TV (tvOS)
items.path: react-native-tvos (Expo supports it through the TV config plugin): one codebase with a focus-based layout and expo-video HLS playback
items.why: Premium living-room screen; the founder asked for smart TVs
items.note: Needs a remote-first UI: focus rings, no text entry, sign-in by phone code

items.name: Android TV and Google TV
items.path: react-native-tvos Android TV target; same build as Fire TV
items.why: Largest TV platform by device count outside Apple; one build also feeds Fire TV
items.note: Needs leanback launcher entry and banner asset

items.name: Amazon Fire TV
items.path: Same Android TV APK from react-native-tvos, submitted to the Amazon Appstore
items.why: Cheap sticks put it in many homes; adds only a store listing once Android TV exists
items.note: Fire OS ships its own player quirks; test on a Fire Stick

items.name: Roku
items.path: Native SceneGraph channel in BrightScript/SceneGraph XML that reads a public JSON feed from apps/api (no React Native on Roku); a Direct Publisher feed is the cheapest start
items.why: Roku is the top US streaming platform by share; creators reach a lean-back audience
items.note: Separate codebase; ideal for an outside contributor who knows Roku

items.name: Samsung TV (Tizen)
items.path: Packaged web app (Tizen Studio) wrapping the web build with spatial-navigation key handling
items.why: Largest TV brand worldwide; the web build is reused
items.note: Needs a TV-safe web layout and a Samsung seller account

items.name: LG TV (webOS)
items.path: Packaged web app (webOS Studio) wrapping the same TV web layout as Tizen
items.why: Second-largest TV brand; shares the Tizen work

items.name: Apple Watch (watchOS)
items.path: Small native SwiftUI companion: notifications for new followers and report status; no feed
items.why: Low exposure for creators; useful for alerts only

items.name: Wear OS
items.path: Small native Kotlin companion for alerts, same scope as watchOS
items.why: Low exposure; alerts only

items.name: CarPlay and Android Auto
items.path: Audio-only: Apple and Google restrict driving apps to audio, navigation, messaging and a few categories, so only a music or podcast post type would fit
items.why: Only makes sense for audio creators once audio posts exist

items.name: Apple Vision Pro
items.path: Run the iPad app in compatibility mode first; native visionOS (SwiftUI/RealityKit) only for a gallery view
items.why: Early adopters and press; works as an iPad app on day one

items.name: Meta Quest
items.path: Web app in the Quest Browser (PWA); a native Horizon app is not worth it yet
items.why: The web build already works in the headset browser

items.name: Browser extension (save and share)
items.path: WebExtension (Chrome, Firefox, Safari): "Post this to Emera" and "Report a copy of this" on any page
items.why: Puts the report-a-copy flow where creators find copies

items.name: Share cards (Open Graph, Twitter Card)
items.path: apps/api renders /@handle and /p/:id with og: tags; add generated card images (title, maker badge) via a Worker image route
items.why: Every link pasted into X, iMessage, Slack and Discord shows the work and the maker
items.note: Pages exist; per-post card image still to build

items.name: oEmbed and embeds
items.path: /oembed endpoint returning JSON for /p/:id plus an iframe embed page, like bskyembed in bluesky-social/social-app
items.why: Blogs, newsletters and Notion embed the post, each one a backlink

items.name: RSS and Atom per creator
items.path: /@handle/feed.xml and /feed.xml from apps/api, with media enclosures
items.why: Readers, podcast apps and automations follow creators with no account

items.name: Email digests
items.path: Weekly Resend digest of followed creators, built from the same feed query; opt-in
items.why: Reaches people who never open an app; early list already collects emails

items.name: Other AT Protocol clients
items.path: Publish social.emera.* lexicons and a docs page; clients read posts through the PDS and AppView APIs
items.why: Instant reach into the existing AT Protocol app ecosystem
items.note: Depends on stage A/B of the own-PDS plan in docs/architecture.md

items.name: Posts visible in Bluesky
items.path: Write a companion app.bsky.feed.post (image and link card back to Emera) beside each social.emera.post, opt-in per creator
items.why: Bluesky has the audience today; every post carries a link back
items.note: Design needs a check on how a custom record and the Bluesky record stay in sync [inferred]

items.name: Feed generator
items.path: Feed generator from bluesky-social/feed-generator that serves "Emera creators" as a custom feed inside Bluesky
items.why: Pinned feeds in Bluesky bring followers without an install

items.name: MCP server and assistant apps
items.path: Read-only MCP server over the public API (search creators, read a post, start a report); a ChatGPT app can wrap the same API
items.why: Assistants can answer "who made this" with a link to the proof

items.name: Smart displays (Echo Show, Nest Hub)
items.path: Web app in the display browser or a Fire TV-style app; digital-frame mode of a creator feed
items.why: Ambient showcase for visual artists; low priority
